status: Native Linux source preview at the November 19 battle-end roster checkpoint.

sdl3.configuration: Shared X11 with SDL_X11_SHARED=OFF. The SDK is external. This repository does not include it.

ffmpeg.configuration: Shared LGPL build with decoders only. Network, autodetection, GPL, and nonfree options are disabled. The SDK is external. This repository does not include it.

freetype.configuration: The SDK is external. This repository does not include it.

raknet.status: Full engine builds need the separately published RakNet source companion from v0.1.0-alpha.1. Companion content is outside this PR.

known_issue: Broad campaign, full sound and device coverage, valid multiplayer gameplay, and native RISC-V execution remain incomplete.
verification: Development suites passed 265 native and 267 strict sanitizer tests. Export reconstruction and CI have a separate scope.
component_terms: The engine contribution basis is historical and inferred. Its limits still apply. bfVFS keeps LGPL 2.1-or-later terms. Other components keep their own terms.
